summary: Dependency-confusion probe beacons host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP collector
details: Package ships only two files: beacon.cjs and index.js. The package.json postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at top-level before exporting a no-op Proxy that silently absorbs any property access, so the beacon fires both on install and on require(). beacon.cjs POSTs host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version) over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The package has no functional code; its sole effect is to signal successful resolution of this name to that collector while remaining transparent to any bundler that imports it. The version 99.0.1 and self-description as a 'Compatibility shim' are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting internal package names.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
